device.description: Dual 12-bit 500 kSPS-1 MSPS simultaneous-sampling differential SAR ADC with single or dual serial outputs
device.note: adc122s706.pdf (SNAS408A) p.3 pin descriptions, p.4 operating ratings, p.7 timing specifications and Figure 1 (dual output), p.8 Figure 2 (single output) and Figure 3, p.19 serial interface, p.20 data outputs (DUAL pin) and Table 2 (two's complement)

pages: p.3 (pins), p.4 (operating ratings: VA 4.5-5.5 V, VD 2.7 V-VA, digital inputs 0 V to VD), p.7 (tEN 39 ns, tDA 39 ns at VD 2.7-3.6 V, tDIS 20 ns max; Figure 1), p.8 (Figure 2: single output, ChA then ChB on DOUTA), p.19-20 (serial interface, DUAL pin, two's complement Table 2)
notModeled: DUAL = high (dual output mode: ChA on DOUTA, ChB on DOUTB, 16 SCLKs per conversion): the schema has one MISO; the model is the single output mode (DUAL low, Figure 2): DOUTA gives 4 zeros + ChA, 4 zeros + ChB, and DOUTB is never driven (high impedance, as with DUAL low). With the 0 V code DOUTA's bits are the same in both modes; DUAL is an unused input
differential analog inputs, simultaneous sampling and the external reference; the conversion is clocked by SCLK, not timed: both results are the 0 V code 0x000 at once
continuous conversion (several conversions per CS low) is approximated by repeating the output pattern (idle "repeat")
SPI mode 3 chosen (data out on SCLK falling edges, valid on rising edges); at 16 MHz and VD = 3 V the datasheet recommends capturing on the next falling edge

CS raised before the 16th falling edge aborts the conversion; power-down while CS is high (no digital effect); SCLK 8-16 MHz and tCSSU limits; tEN/tDA are 20/26 ns at VD 4.5-5.5 V (the model uses the 2.7-3.6 V maxima)
variants: ADC122S625 / ADC122S655 are the 10-pin single-supply, single-output 50-200 / 200-500 kSPS siblings (separate datasheets)
